observation.target: lower-right green leaf and adjacent faint writing
observation.description: The lower-right green leaf is a painted, serrated leaf mass. The faint brown writing is immediately below its lower edge in the adjacent pale page area, with a roughly horizontal baseline and writing-sized repeated strokes. It is outside the visible green fill. I do not see a writing stroke continuing as a leaf edge, vein, or stem, nor a closed boundary enclosing the writing. The isolated writing much higher at the right belongs to a separate upper plant area and is not merged with this lower-right record.
uncertainty: The faint lower writing is low contrast and its exact glyph boundaries are not assigned.
The relationship between the writing and the nearby leaf cannot be given an authorial ownership interpretation from proximity alone.
No paint-layer order or chronology was assessed.
observation.claim_ceiling: Native visual localization only; no literal reading, plant identity, owner assignment, or translation.
